\begin{abstract}
One question organises every project this term: \emph{with today's AI tools, what LLM research can a team of two or three finish in four weeks and write up as a research report?} The final project is a small research study in natural language processing: choose one question, build a baseline, and test a targeted change under a fixed budget. The deliverables are a poster presentation, a research report, and reproducibility materials. This guide merges the project briefs and the Lecture 8 topics into eight tracks (A--H, 79 briefs), ordered from the most popular and easiest to grasp to the more specialised, with competitions and entrepreneurship last. It follows the course web page section by section, \url{https://nlp-course-cuhksz.github.io/final-project.html}, which adds embedded videos, a track finder and a Chinese version. This guide covers CSC5051, CSC6052, and MDS5110. Version of November 13, 2026.
\end{abstract}
